text: As I move through this impeccably modern space, I am struck by the interplay of clarity and abstraction. The hard lines of glass and steel outside the exhibition give way to the playful, vivid displays of the R+D wall. I feel intrigued—eager to contemplate not just the content of research and development, but the presentation itself. The vibrant colors and interactive screens invite me to question how knowledge is framed and shared. I am both observer and participant, aware of my own curiosity growing amidst these curated fragments of innovation.
